Custom ML Model

AbserneyVision

A custom MobileNetV2 image classification model trained via transfer learning, serving as an additional offline detection layer inside the Abserny mobile app. Targets 13 common indoor object categories with a current validation accuracy of 37%.

Training in Progress

Overview

AbserneyVision is a lightweight image classification model designed to run entirely on-device without any network connection. It supplements ML Kit's general-purpose labeling with a model trained specifically for the indoor environments Abserny users most frequently encounter.

The model is integrated into the Abserny mobile app as a third classification layer — after Gemini (online) and ML Kit (offline general), AbserneyVision provides category-specific confidence scores for the 13 target classes.

⚠
Work in progress Current validation accuracy is 37%. Dataset expansion is ongoing. The model is functional and deployed in v1.0 but not yet at the 80%+ target.

Architecture

The model uses MobileNetV2 as its base, chosen for its efficiency on mobile hardware. Transfer learning from ImageNet pre-trained weights is applied, with the final classification head replaced and trained from scratch on the Abserny dataset.

  • Base: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet pre-trained)
  • Input: 224 × 224 RGB image
  • Output: 13-class softmax
  • Training data: ImageNet subsets + Microsoft COCO subsets
  • Framework: TensorFlow / TensorFlow Lite for mobile export

Target Categories

The 13 indoor object categories the model is trained to classify:

  • Chair
  • Table / desk
  • Door
  • Window
  • Stairs / steps
  • Person
  • Laptop / computer
  • Cup / bottle
  • Book
  • Bag / backpack
  • Bed / sofa
  • Phone
  • Sign / text surface

Training Details

Dataset

Training data is sourced from filtered subsets of ImageNet and Microsoft COCO, selecting only images belonging to the 13 target categories. Dataset expansion with additional real-world indoor images is ongoing as part of the effort to reach 80%+ validation accuracy.

Mobile Integration

The TFLite model is bundled inside the Abserny APK and runs via TensorFlow Lite on-device. It is invoked in the SCANNING state alongside ML Kit, and its top-1 prediction is incorporated into the spoken description when confidence exceeds the threshold.

Roadmap

  • Expand dataset to 5,000+ images per category
  • Evaluate MobileNetV3 and EfficientNet-Lite alternatives
  • Add spatial position estimation (left / center / right / near / far)
  • Reach 80%+ validation accuracy milestone
  • Explore real-time object tracking across frames
